cuerpo.name: LNReader v2.1.4
cuerpo.body:
This release adds shared-link support, crash reporting, and more control over categories and background tasks, along with safer backup restores and a round of stability fixes.

### New features

- Open a novel directly, or search for it, by sharing its URL to LNReader.
- Find crash logs and diagnostic details in Advanced settings to help troubleshoot issues.
- Set category selection to "Always ask" to choose categories each time you add a novel to your library.
- Show optional continue reading buttons on novel covers and list items in the library.
- Cancel any queued or running background task individually from the task queue.

### Improvements

- Refined the custom code editor, snippet controls, genre taxonomy screen, and statistics layout.
- Reduced background task memory usage and improved task lifecycle management.
- Backup restores are now non-destructive and preserve existing data where appropriate.
- Updated translations.

### Fixes

- Fixed crashes when chapter or novel names are missing.
- Fixed blank or empty-state flashes when opening the chapter drawer and novel screen.
- Fixed bottom navigation icons shifting when switching tabs.
- Fixed text-to-speech handling of dash-only dividers and surrounding quotation marks.
- Fixed newline handling in the code editor and restored the broken preview.

cuerpo.name: LNReader v2.1.3
cuerpo.body:
LNReader v2.1.3 focuses on the new stats screen, several reader and library stability fixes, and a handful of quality-of-life improvements.

#### ✨ New Features
- Add genre screen, charts, and normalization to the stats UI
- Add more novel status types and icons
- Create a dedicated custom code settings page (V2)
- Increase maximum text size limit in the Reader and Settings from 20 to 50

#### 🚀 Performance & Refactors
- Fix novel screen scroll lag, source pagination stalls, and skeleton overlap
- Space optimization improvements
- Refetch library after category updates

#### 🛠 Fixes
- Remove white flash during screen transitions
- Fix migration crash
- Fix stats screen logic issue
- Include all chapters beyond the 1000-row UI limit in backups
- TTS no longer continues playing during incoming/outgoing phone calls
- Pass plugin `imageRequestInit` headers to detail cover images
- Refresh empty chapters in the reader
- Upload JS source map

#### 📝 Docs
- Add `AGENTS.md` with agent setup, commands, and conventions
- Update translations

## New Contributors

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lnreader/lnreader/compare/v2.1.2...v2.1.3

cuerpo.name: LNReader v2.1.2
cuerpo.body:
This follow-up hotfix improves migration recovery, library consistency, and overall stability across LNReader v2.1.x.

> [!NOTE]
> If an earlier v2.1.x upgrade was interrupted, update without clearing the app's data or reinstalling. LNReader will retry and repair the migration during the next launch.

## Fixed

- Improved recovery for interrupted chapter database migrations.
- Fixed migration failures caused by older chapter snapshots missing newer database fields.
- Kept library counters, update timestamps, and date-based sorting accurate after chapter updates.
- Refreshed library data after manually updating a novel or completing an EPUB import.
- Preserved the default category when reordering categories ([#1922](https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader/issues/1922)).
- Prevented crashes when novels contain missing or malformed genre information.
- Removed a white seam that could appear beside the Reader chapter drawer.
- Improved preview-build support for forks without access to upstream secrets.
- Prevented forked repositories from sending LNReader Discord build notifications ([#1923](https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader/pull/1923)).
- Updated translations.

Thank you to all contributors, translators, testers, and everyone who reported issues or shared feedback for this release.

**Full Changelog:** [`v2.1.1...v2.1.2`](https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader/compare/v2.1.1...v2.1.2)

cuerpo.name: LNReader v2.1.1
cuerpo.body:
This hotfix focuses on database recovery, backups, and background-task reliability following the v2.1.0 release.

> [!NOTE]
> If your library stopped loading after v2.1.0, update directly to v2.1.1 without clearing app data or reinstalling. LNReader will attempt to repair the database during the first launch, which may take slightly longer than usual.

## Fixed

* Repaired skipped database migrations affecting users upgrading from v2.0.x.
* Restored missing library entries, chapter counters, download badges, unread badges, and history timestamps.
* Fixed chapter read/download updates failing with SQLite query errors.
* Fixed backup restoration failures caused by the damaged database schema.
* Preserved novels, chapters, categories, and reading progress during database repair.
* Added recovery for interrupted or partially completed migrations.
* Improved migration compatibility for existing `scanlator` and reading-time data.
* Fixed repository-screen back navigation.
* Improved bottom-navigation alignment.

## Backup improvements

* Improved local, Google Drive, and self-hosted backup handling.
* Added selectable backup sections for library, settings, plugins, and downloaded files.
* Improved backup and restore progress reporting.
* Added clearer completion messages and warnings for partially restored backups.
* Improved restoration of installed plugins.
* Maintained support for older backup formats.

## Background tasks

* Added separate task queues so unrelated operations can run independently.
* Added per-plugin download limits.
* Added clearer queued-task feedback.
* Improved completion notifications for backups, downloads, migrations, updates, and EPUB exports.
* EPUB exports now provide a durable notification when completed.

If you previously cleared the app's data, v2.1.1 cannot recover the deleted local database; you will still need to restore an available backup.

---

## What's new in v2.1.x

v2.1.1 is a hotfix release. If you're updating directly to v2.1.1, you'll also receive all of the features, improvements, and fixes introduced in v2.1.0.

> [!NOTE]
> Because the v2.1 release series includes database and native-platform migrations, creating a backup before upgrading is recommended.

## Highlights

### Library Updates

* Schedule automatic library updates.
* Update novels from multiple sources in parallel.
* Choose which categories are included in global updates.
* Skip updates intelligently using configurable smart filters.
* Remember the last selected library category.

### Reader and TTS

* Search for text within the current chapter, including while using bionic reading.
* Open chapters faster with fewer reading-time re-renders.
* Improved paged-reader layout, navigation, controls, and bottom-inset handling.
* Rebuilt Android TTS media playback with TTS engine selection.
* Added collapsible TTS controls and more reliable notification progress.
* Added descriptions to reader settings.
* Restored saved chapter progress more reliably.

### Statistics and Personalisation

* Added reading-time tracking and expanded statistics.
* Added controls for time tracking and inactivity timeout.
* Added configurable date formats and relative timestamps.
* Added dynamic Material theme colours on supported Android devices.
* Refreshed dialogs, sliders, tabs, menus, and bottom sheets with Material 3 styling.

### EPUB Improvements

* Rebuilt EPUB exporting using a native implementation.
* Added export progress notifications.
* Added chapter numbers to exported chapter titles.
* Improved the EPUB export interface and error reporting.
* Fixed chapter ordering across paginated sources.
* Fixed imports and exports involving missing images and unusual filenames.

### Browse, Migration, and Networking

* Added scanlator filtering.
* Added review options when migrating novels between sources.
* Added an address bar to the in-app WebView.
* Added optional DNS-over-HTTPS support on Android.
* Added a configurable cooldown between chapter downloads.
* Improved the plugin browsing and settings experience.

## Fixes and Performance

* Restored tracker search requests.
* Fixed missing MyAnimeList entries and null progress handling.
* Fixed next-chapter selection and chapter-list selection highlighting.
* Fixed active filters not being reflected in chapter counts.
* Fixed database transaction errors and migration history.
* Fixed the WebView resetting when reader settings changed.
* Fixed TTS text normalisation and collapsed-control interaction.
* Improved novel covers, lists, chapter groups, skeleton loading, and the Novel screen.
* Improved category badge layout and drag reordering.
* Improved history removal and empty-chapter reporting.
* Fixed several crashes involving EPUB imports and native file operations.
* Included numerous additional interface, localisation, stability, and performance fixes.

## Platform Updates

* Upgraded to Expo 55 and migrated to the Expo managed workflow.
* Migrated the database layer to Drizzle and `op-sqlite`.
* Migrated background work to native Android scheduling.
* Refreshed Android icons, splash screens, and build variants.
* Reorganised the project and modernised several native components.

## New Contributors

* @tomsLt0 in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader/pull/1744
* @Definisi in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader/pull/1797
* @tinywind in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader/pull/1829
* @VictorPersona in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader/pull/1845
* @Jaky-gh in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader/pull/1850
* @alirafiqmalik in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader/pull/1873
* @vikas-movva in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader/pull/1869
* @luigidotmoe in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader/pull/1864
* @Shisii in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader/pull/1877
* @Ecasept in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader/pull/1884
* @amir-rezaei in https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader/pull/1892

Thank you to all contributors, translators, testers, and everyone who reported issues or shared feedback for this release.

**Full Changelog (v2.1.1):** https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader/compare/v2.1.0...v2.1.1

cuerpo.name: LNReader v.2.0.3
cuerpo.body:
> [!CAUTION]
> This version has a migration issue. If you're upgrading to this release, install version 2.0.2 first before updating to this version.

> [!WARNING]
> Backup data from version 1.1.19 does not include downloads or reading progress. Downloaded content and reading progress will not transfer to LNReader 2.0.

#### ✨ New Features

* Show first unread chapter in Read button and FAB when no last read exists
* Add Kitsu tracker integration
* Support additional plugin setting types (dropdowns and checkboxes)
* Allow all safe tags and attributes when sanitizing chapter HTML
* Add RTL (Right-to-Left) language support
* Add `@noble/ciphers` support for plugins
* Add volume button offset setting

#### 🚀 Performance & Refactors

* Optimize Library screen performance and fix category bug
* Optimize Novel screen performance and improve download state tracking
* Replace sync DB operations with async to prevent database locks
* Improve transaction handling with `withExclusiveTransactionAsync`
* Stabilize scroll handler references to prevent infinite re-renders
* Update components to follow Material Design 3 guidelines
* Replace react-native-paper menus with custom implementation

#### 🛠 Fixes

* Miscellaneous UI tweaks
* Prevent tab bar height jump and shadow flash on Browse screen
* Pre-fetch adjacent chapters in Reader and during library updates
* Order chapter pages numerically for accurate retrieval
* Fix chapter loading in Jump-to-Chapter modal and chapter drawer
* Sanitize EPUB filenames to remove filesystem-unsafe characters
* Prevent EPUB import crash loops (DocumentPicker cache, IOException handling)
* Use NativeFile for custom CSS/JS imports to fix content URI issues
* Close OkHttp responses and streams properly
* Remove missing image references during EPUB export
* Add max height to Set Categories modal
* Show plugin settings when updates introduce new options

cuerpo.name: LNReader v2.0.2
cuerpo.body:
LNReader v2.0.2 is a follow‑up to v2.0.1 focused on stability, TTS behavior, and a few UI and data‑handling fixes.

> [!WARNING]
> Backup data from version 1.1.19 does not include downloads or reading progress. Downloaded content and reading progress will not transfer to LNReader 2.0.

> [!NOTE]
> LNReader no longer includes pre-installed plugin repositories. To add repositories, visit: https://www.lnreader.app/plugins

### Reader and UI

- Reader now shows page names instead of only numbers, and the jump‑to‑chapter modal uses the full chapter list.
- Battery level display in the reader footer updates correctly when chapters change.

### TTS and background

- TTS handling has been adjusted to avoid overflow issues and to start more reliably from the first paragraph.
- Reading and TTS can now continue while the app is in the background.

### Library, backup, and data

- Category and updates lists have improved sorting behavior.
- Backup now skips failed entities instead of failing entirely, and DB/PRAGMA calls have better error handling, improving offline stability.

cuerpo.name: LNReader v2.0.1
cuerpo.body:
This patch release provides small improvements following the 2.0.0 update.

## Changes

### Feature

* Added progress notifications for local backup creation and restore.

### Fixes

* Library updates now use `INSERT OR IGNORE` to avoid duplicate entry issues.
* The default category is created only if it does not already exist.


## If You Missed 2.0.0

Version 2.0.0 introduced major structural changes, including a new plugin system, an updated reader engine, revised backup formats, improved EPUB handling, and several UI and performance updates. Reviewing the 2.0.0 notes is recommended before upgrading.

cuerpo.name: LNReader v2.0.0
cuerpo.body:
LNReader 2.0 introduces a rebuilt plugin system, a redesigned reader engine, improved backup options, major UI updates, and extensive performance and stability improvements.

> [!WARNING]
> Backup data from version 1.1.19 does not include downloads or reading progress. Downloaded content and reading progress will not transfer to LNReader 2.0.

> [!NOTE]
> LNReader no longer includes pre-installed plugin repositories. To add repositories, visit: https://www.lnreader.app/plugins

## Highlights

### **Plugins**

* Complete plugin system overhaul with dedicated storage.
* Updated plugin hosts, improved configuration options, and better developer experience.
* Faster global search and improved swipe behavior.

### **Reader**

* Reader rewritten in vanJS for better performance.
* Page Reader updates: chapter caching, EPUB chapter merging, improved padding, and smoother navigation.
* Updated Reader footer, context menu, and Reader Settings UI.

### **Backups**

* Support for Google Drive and remote backups.
* New ZIP backup format and a reimplemented local backup system.
* More reliable restore handling.

### **EPUB & Files**

* EPUB parsing rewritten in C++ for Android.
* Improved file manager, custom storage folder support, and more reliable cover handling.

### **UI & UX**

* Updated bottom navigation, themes, icons, and splash screen.
* FilterSheet redesign and more consistent spacing.
* Dynamic novel app bar and improved bottom sheets.

### **Performance & Architecture**

* React Native 0.72 upgrade and new architecture support.
* Kotlin migration for Android components.
* FlashList reinstated with fixes, faster task queue, and reduced rendering time.
* TypeScript conversion and MMKV-based storage.

### **Other Features**

* MangaUpdates tracker.
* Multi-language reading option.
* Additional HTML tag support and improved sanitization.

## Stability & Fixes

Numerous fixes across reader behavior, navigation, downloads, category updates, parsing logic, global search, and UI alignment. Overall stability and responsiveness have been significantly improved.


## Localization

New French and Thai translations, Arabic alignment fixes, and general translation updates.


## New Contributors

@he0119, @Palloxin, @Batorian, @elfing44, @Soopyboo32, @Skeltons, @Anan5a, @NilSilva, @br14n-sol, @MOA-YAD, @jacksin125, @Neel-shetty, @rvx05, @ilonachan, @yammyy 


Full Changelog: [https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader/compare/v1.1.19...v2.0.0](https://github.com/LNReader/lnreader/compare/v1.1.19...v2.0.0)
